title: Unknown Venetian envoy to the Doge (Ser.mo Principe), 29 April 1628 (DECODE R1862)

documents.shelfmark: Archivio di Stato di Venezia, IT ASVe 0045 010 (Serie) Busta 27 f. 354; DECODE R1862

plaintext.source: No decipherment in the record; key rebuilt from the sibling R1874, whose contemporary decipherment is imaged with it.

transcription.source: Transcribed here from the four DECODE images (no DECODE transcription on the record).
transcription.notes: Made here from the four images, then checked line by line against them with the key in hand (five passes). Two rows of page 2 had been blended from two physical lines and one row was a phantom; found by tracking baselines.

system.summary: Numerical syllabary: prefix = vowel (6 a, 51 e, 62 i, 53 o, 64 u), final two digits = consonant; plus single letters, word codes and paragraph marks.
system.sibling_key: R1874 (Mocenigo, Madrid 1628), key rebuilt from its contemporary decipherment
system.notes: 698/5198/5199 mark the edges of ciphered passages, as 6499 does in R1874. Key order: a tabular vowel x consonant grid, the consonant columns roughly alphabetical (07 b, 08 c, 10 d, 11 f, 13 g, 19 l, 20 m, 21 n, 22 p, 24 qu, 27 r, 28 s, 33 t, 37 v, 38 z).

prior_solution.where: CSP Venice vol. 21 calendars no Rome despatch of 29 Apr 1628; not in Tomokiyo or Bonavoglia.

conditions.human_role: Posed the target from the catalogue; DECODE account cookie.

solution.what: Fetched the four images with the stored DECODE cookie; the record has no transcription.
CSP Venice vol. 21, 23-30 April 1628: only the London despatch of 29 April is calendared; this letter is not.

Group-exact transcription of R1862 by an agent (digit shapes b=6, s=5, hook=2, >=7, g=9; 5-forms "s3"=53, "si"=51). The R1874 transcription agent stopped (ambiguous hand); DECODE's own R1874 transcription used instead.
Transcribed R1874's contemporary decipherment (images 8955-8959, paragraphs 5-16, ~4,800 letters) as known plaintext.

Soft-EM forward-backward alignment of R1874 code groups (DECODE transcription, 5-forms unmerged: '21'=51, '13'=53) to the decipherment, 5 segment pairs, 2,398 groups; first run with nulls allowed collapsed, rerun with 1-4 letters per group converged.

Key is a vowel x consonant syllabary: prefix 6=a, 51=e, 62=i, 53=o, 64=u; final pair 08 c,10 d,11 f,13 g,18 h,19 l,20 m,21 n,22 p,24 qu,27 r,28 s,33 t,37 v,38 z; single letters 680 a, 6280 e, 6480 i, 5190 o; words 670 che, 672 con, 5374 per, 6249 il.
R1874 key applied unchanged to R1862 page 1: continuous Italian ('ricercavo con intiera confidenza', 'serenissima republica').
Key applied to all four pages; nomenclator codes read from context (5384 qual(che), 5331 sto, 5373 part, 5387 quel, 537 ro, 6477 poc, 6240 ave, 5347 papa, 6481 stri).
Agents re-checked every line against the images with the key (glyph calibration: final n-shape = 2, 7 = long-tailed >, 9 = g), correcting digit slips and group splits.
Five image passes over the transcription with the key in hand; found and fixed two rows blended from two physical lines and one phantom row on page 2.
LM hill-climb over key values for weak/unknown groups.
Pages 1, 3 and 4 and the first half of page 2 read continuously; 20 word-code tokens and page 2 lines 18-28 left unread.

outcome.notes: Key rebuilt from the sibling R1874 and applied unchanged. 98.4% of the code-group tokens have a value; 84% of them stand in lines that read as continuous Italian (measure.py, it-cinquecento). Work stopped at the session rate limit, not at a blocker.

gaps.item: 20 code-group tokens (1.6%) in the word/name band of the key

gaps.detail: transcribed and largely image-true; split boundaries and 5/2, 3/7, 6/0/8 confusions at the limit of this scan
